svg.title: Video editing mode — the editor in Video mode
svg.desc: The Mainframe Editor in Video mode with a recording open: menus File Edit View Video Help; a toolbar with play and stop, the position 1:02.3 of 6:00.0, Transcribe, Remove fillers, Detect silence and Detect idle gameplay buttons, the kept time, an Export button and a Game or Video toggle set to Video; a tab strip with two video tabs; a letterboxed game frame in the preview; a transcript panel on the right with filler words struck through and the current word highlighted; an amber notice line with the last result; and a timeline with a ruler, two gameplay markers, kept regions in blue and removed regions in grey labelled loading, idle and paused, a waveform and a red playhead.
svg.text: Click: cut / restore · Drag: a run · ⌘-click: play from here
⚠ Cut 3 stretches of idle gameplay, 0:42.1 removed. · 7 filler words removed.
Toolbar: transport, the analysis jobs (Transcribe, Detect silence: “Cancel n %” while running), kept time, Export, Game | Video.
Tabs: each recording or .mfcut is a tab; video mode shows only video tabs (scene and song tabs stay open in Game mode).
Preview: ffmpeg-decoded frames in an engine texture, fitted to the video’s aspect; plays the edit gaplessly.
Transcript: one span per word; cut words are struck through; the current word follows the playhead.
Notice line: open warnings and the last operation’s result (Cutback’s wording).
Timeline: Cutback’s gestures, kept and removed regions with reasons, waveform, gameplay markers, playhead.
As built. Video editing mode: the whole editor UI switches to a Cutback-style layout (VideoPanel, video.rml).
